evidence.existingTasks: original task 0b492286 appears to have been the source task; no live task row found (orphan)

riskNotes: Changes are test-only. No production code, routes, services, or config files touched. The db.test.js mock fix is a correctness improvement. tests/0b492286.test.js uses a custom assert-based runner inside a .test.js file — Jest will discover and run it; if the file exits via process.exit() Jest may flag it, but the file itself validates lib/db.js API contract without real connections.
recommendation: Create a task and PR to merge this branch. The test additions are valid and beneficial — they improve coverage of lib/db.js and fix a pg mock isolation gap in the existing db.test.js unit test. Review whether tests/0b492286.test.js should be converted to proper Jest describe/it blocks before merging to avoid suite-level warnings.
